summary: Pilot: draft golden-queries files for three works from their chunks, for owner ratification in PR review

resolution.note: Three pilots drafted from live corpus v50 chunks: 12 recall probes (4 per work, provenance recorded) + 6 relevance queries. All probes verified surviving top-15 via the integration gate; 4 first drafts that missed top-15 were retuned with reader-honest name anchors, recorded in note fields. corpus-hermeticum marked frozenEval for the work-disjoint eval subset.
